$description: Primitive palette, terminal ANSI set, and radii. Product components must not consume these directly. Colours are oklch; terminal ANSI is sRGB because xterm consumes it as-is.

neutral.$description: Ramp seated on the approved light mockup. Ground/surface/text are cool-biased (hue ~248-262); the `fill` and `line` steps lean warm-neutral (hue ~106), which is how the mockup draws them — a hand-picked ramp, not one generated from a single hue. `fill` is the mockup's `--n-raised`. Whisper-quiet near the ground, then a hard jump to text.

location.$description: The only chromatic axis. Matched lightness and chroma, opposite hues, so neither location outranks the other. Lightness sits ~0.008 below the mockup's, which is the minimum that clears AA on the chrome surface the mockup itself puts these colours on (its legend quoted canvas ratios). Hue and chroma are the mockup's, unchanged.

action.$description: Hue ~158 is the midpoint of the 55 <-> 255 arc taken the 200-degree way round: the colour of crossing over. Lightness as for `location`, and for the same reason.

state.$description: danger and warning only. There is deliberately no success colour: healthy is neutral (visual-language.md P6).

dark.$description: Dark counterpart. The mapping exists so the token architecture is theme-complete; no dark UI ships yet, and these values are not part of the verified surface. Treated as unreviewed until a dark theme is an actual deliverable.

terminal.$description: Nession's own 16-colour ANSI set, shared by both themes (the terminal is light-only for now). white/brightWhite are reverse-video background slots and deliberately do not clear AA as text — see docs/design/visual-language.md. Consumed by xterm via the generated terminal theme, not as CSS vars.

typography.$description: Shared body scale for composer/capsule — web and app consume via experience composer refs, not directly.
